{
  "name": "mailloop",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "private": true,
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "next dev",
    "build": "next build",
    "start": "next start",
    "lint": "eslint",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "test": "vitest run",
    "test:e2e": "tsx scripts/test-usage-db.ts --e2e-only --browser=.spec",
    "db:generate": "prisma generate",
    "db:migrate": "prisma migrate dev",
    "db:deploy": "prisma migrate deploy",
    "db:clear": "tsx scripts/reset-local-data.ts",
    "inngest:dev": "npx --yes inngest-cli@latest dev -u http://localhost:3000/api/inngest",
    "postinstall": "prisma generate",
    "test:db": "MAILLOOP_DB_TESTS=1 vitest run tests/*.db.test.ts",
    "format": "prettier --write src tests *.config.ts *.config.mts README.md",
    "test:usage:db": "tsx scripts/test-usage-db.ts",
    "tokens:rotate": "node --conditions=react-server --import tsx scripts/rotate-token-encryption.ts",
    "usage:backfill": "node --conditions=react-server --import tsx scripts/backfill-subscription-usage.ts",
    "billing:recover": "node --conditions=react-server --import tsx scripts/subscription-maintenance.ts recover",
    "billing:reconcile": "node --conditions=react-server --import tsx scripts/subscription-maintenance.ts reconcile",
    "subscriptions:sweep": "node --conditions=react-server --import tsx scripts/subscription-maintenance.ts sweep",
    "check:colors": "tsx scripts/check-colors.ts",
    "pretest": "npm run check:colors",
    "prebuild": "npm run check:colors",
    "test:themes": "tsx scripts/test-usage-db.ts --e2e-only --browser=theme-audit,appearance,ring-completion",
    "audit:themes:report": "tsx scripts/report-theme-audit.ts",
    "pretest:e2e": "npm run check:colors",
    "pretest:themes": "npm run check:colors"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@next/third-parties": "16.4.3",
    "@prisma/adapter-pg": "7.10.0",
    "@prisma/client": "7.10.0",
    "@radix-ui/react-dialog": "1.3.1",
    "@radix-ui/react-slot": "1.4.0",
    "@vercel/analytics": "^2.0.1",
    "@vercel/blob": "2.8.1",
    "@vercel/speed-insights": "^2.1.0",
    "class-variance-authority": "0.7.1",
    "clsx": "2.1.1",
    "dodopayments": "2.55.0",
    "dotenv": "18.0.6",
    "gmail-mime": "npm:nodemailer@10.0.16",
    "googleapis": "^183.0.0",
    "inngest": "4.22.0",
    "lucide-react": "1.52.0",
    "next": "16.4.3",
    "next-auth": "^5.0.0-beta.32",
    "papaparse": "5.7.0",
    "pg": "8.23.1",
    "react": "19.3.0",
    "react-dom": "19.3.0",
    "server-only": "0.0.1",
    "standardwebhooks": "1.1.1",
    "tailwind-merge": "3.7.0",
    "zod": "4.6.5"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@axe-core/playwright": "4.13.0",
    "@playwright/test": "1.63.0",
    "@tailwindcss/postcss": "^4.3.3",
    "@types/node": "22.20.5",
    "@types/nodemailer": "8.0.2",
    "@types/papaparse": "5.5.2",
    "@types/pg": "8.23.1",
    "@types/react": "^19",
    "@types/react-dom": "^19",
    "eslint": "^9",
    "eslint-config-next": "16.4.3",
    "prettier": "3.9.9",
    "prisma": "7.10.0",
    "tailwindcss": "^4",
    "tsx": "4.23.15",
    "typescript": "^5",
    "vitest": "5.0.3"
  },
  "packageManager": "npm@11.19.0"
}
